items.title: SoundX AI
items.transcript: This is SoundX AI. It merges Sound Deck AI and the SoundX studio into one browser app. There are pads, a sequencer, a plugin rack, and song, pattern and piano views. The God Mode hub holds sixty cards. The AI Producer takes a written request, like add drums, and proposes a change. The session changes only when you apply it. It works offline, with no account and no API key.
items.script_sources: SoundX AI README; /case-studies/soundx/; live app UI

items.title: JobNet Application
items.transcript: This is JobNet Application, Katlego's career pipeline in one app. It ranks job listings against real CV evidence and explains every match, using on-device sentence embeddings or a keyword fallback. Pick a role, and AI Hawk drafts a cover note and CV synopsis built only from published facts. Anything it can't back up stays a placeholder. You review it, then copy it or forward it yourself. Nothing is ever sent or applied for automatically. Around the draft sits a toolkit of fifteen tools, from an honest ATS check to interview prep.
items.script_sources: /apps/jobnet/ page copy (JobNet Application, new UI: shortlist, AI Hawk draft, toolkit, guardrails)

items.title: Forex Mercatus Codex
items.transcript: This is Forex Mercatus Codex, a gold-first research terminal for paper trading only. There is no broker connection and no live orders. It charts real historical data for nine symbols. A strategy lab runs walk-forward tests and Monte Carlo, and on-device machine learning reports its honest out-of-sample score. Model outputs are probabilities with measured error, never guarantees. There are risk tools, a pattern scanner, a South African session clock and a trade journal. Everything runs in your browser.
items.script_sources: /apps/forex-codex/ page copy; Forex Mercatus Codex God Mode README
